terminology_highlights: CKD (Completely Knocked Down) — Kits of motorcycle parts imported or exported for local assembly.
JIT (Just-In-Time) — Inventory strategy aligning raw-material orders from suppliers directly with production schedules at the Gurugram plant.
VMI (Vendor Managed Inventory) — A model where tier-1 component suppliers manage inventory levels at Suzuki's staging areas.
PDI (Pre-Delivery Inspection) — Final quality and compliance checks performed on two-wheelers before dealership handover.
